needs_result.text: Integrated the agent into a React front end with real-time gene alias enrichment.

Proposed the request flow: a user's text goes through the API and a customised prompt to the MCP server, where one LLM instance writes GraphQL queries against the client's Convex database and a second instance runs the statistical analysis before the result returns to the user.

Designed reproducible scikit-learn pipelines with feature engineering (temporal features, interaction terms, target encoding), model selection, cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning across classification and regression tasks.

Working independently for India-based startups and individual clients, built agentic RAG workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB) on GCP Cloud Run, NLP pipelines (Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama) and scikit-learn pipelines, served ML models as REST APIs (FastAPI, Docker), and contributed to a team LoRA fine-tune of a Llama model.
Implemented offline-first data persistence (Isar) with background synchronisation in the Flutter FinTech app, keeping financial records available in low-connectivity conditions.

Needed a voice assistant that answers in real time and can be interrupted: built it end to end as a full-stack application (React front end, FastAPI and Google ADK back end, full-duplex WebSocket) with ReAct-based agent orchestration, barge-in handling and self-hosted speech models on Docker/CUDA (float16 inference, model warm-up) to cut latency.

bullets.text: Working independently for India-based startups and individual clients, built agentic RAG workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB) on GCP Cloud Run, NLP pipelines (Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama) and scikit-learn pipelines, served ML models as REST APIs (FastAPI, Docker), and contributed to a team LoRA fine-tune of a Llama model.
Built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deployed as FastAPI services in Docker.

Built a tool-calling LLM agent (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Claude Haiku 4.5) for a multi-omics cancer research platform, with three tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation and dataset provenance.
Predicted bank-customer churn with a supervised XGBoost propensity classifier in R (tidymodels): two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter tuning, SMOTE inside the preprocessing recipe and MCC evaluation.

bullets.text: Deterministic comparable-company matching over 221 profiles and 1,116 cover lines with a single LLM call for rationale, at ~£0.003 per query and under 3 s.

bullets.entry: CoverFit — insurance benchmarking API (Bristol × UWE AI Hackathon)
bullets.text: An insurance sponsor needed a fast, low-cost, explainable benchmark (hackathon brief): paired a deterministic matching engine (FastAPI, pandas, Pydantic) with a single LLM call (Gemini via LiteLLM) for the rationale, covered by pytest tests; responses arrive in under 3 seconds at ~£0.003 per query.
Built a production RAG and agentic retrieval system (Claude API, LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB) served through a FastAPI REST API in Docker on GCP Cloud Run.

Needed a voice assistant that answers in real time and can be interrupted: built it end to end as a full-stack application (React front end, FastAPI and Google ADK back end, full-duplex WebSocket) with ReAct-based agent orchestration, barge-in handling and self-hosted speech models on Docker/CUDA (float16 inference, model warm-up) to cut latency.

Needed an agent that researchers could trust on a cancer research platform, including when its tools fail: built a tool-calling agent (LangChain, Claude Haiku 4.5 on AWS Bedrock) for three use cases (gene alias resolution, prompt-engineered explanations of a fixed scoring pipeline, validated dataset descriptions), with deterministic Ensembl and HGNC calls, deterministic hallucination guards, and circuit breakers with a 19,213-gene parquet fallback for when the external APIs are unavailable.

Built the Python data pipeline: reconciled 14 heterogeneous source datasets through identifier crosswalks so the agent used trusted data, then deployed it as a Docker image on AWS Lambda (ECR, least-privilege IAM) and documented the architecture and evaluation.

paragraphs: Your team will be designing solutions for complex challenges. That is the kind of problem I have been working on. For my AstraZeneca-affiliated MSc dissertation I built a tool-calling LLM agent that keeps working when its data sources fail, deployed it on AWS Lambda and checked it with a three-tier framework of ~65 automated tests. After a rate-limit evaluation moved the agent from Groq to AWS Bedrock, I used the same tests to confirm it still behaved.

I care about the parts that make AI usable: grounding answers in trusted data through deterministic lookups, hallucination guards, and fallbacks for when external APIs go down. I also wrote the project's agent evaluation, including a documented hallucination-rate analysis. At 180 Degrees Consulting I prototyped an agentic tool for a loosely defined client brief and contributed to the client's production MCP server, now in live use; senior leadership rated the engagement five stars. At the Bristol × UWE AI Hackathon I paired a deterministic matching engine with a single LLM call, answering in under 3 seconds at about £0.003 per query. As a freelance engineer I built a production RAG and agentic retrieval system with LangChain and LangGraph.
Your ad asks for AI / ML solutions using LLMs, which is the work I want to do next.
Could we spend 20 minutes on how the team designs solutions for complex challenges?

skills.Machine Learning, Deep Learning & Statis: Predictive modelling (gradient boosting with XGBoost, random forest, scikit-learn), clustering (K-Means, HAC, DBSCAN, Leiden), deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, LSTM, GRU, BiRNN, CNN), time-series forecasting (cyclic time encoding, TimeSeriesSplit), anomaly detection (Isolation Forest), class-imbalance handling (SMOTE), hyper-parameter tuning (grid search, two-stage Bayesian), model evaluation (held-out, cross-validation, Pearson, MCC), statistical inference and experimental design (confidence intervals, bootstrap, hypothesis testing; MSc coursework), MLflow experiment tracking
skills.Python, Data Quality & Cloud: Python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, SQL, PostgreSQL, R (tidymodels), identifier crosswalks, parquet, reproducible pipelines, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), serverless deployment (Lambda, Cloud Run), containerisation, GitHub Actions CI/CD, FastAPI, TensorFlow Serving, pytest, Git
skills.NLP, LLMs, Embeddings & Evaluation: NLP (text preprocessing, TF-IDF, SBERT embeddings, text clustering), Hugging Face Transformers, large language models (Claude, OpenAI, open-weight via Ollama), prompt engineering, RAG with embeddings (ChromaDB), agents (LangChain, LangGraph), team LoRA fine-tune of Llama, LLM evaluation (hallucination-rate analysis, deterministic guardrails)
skills.Client Delivery & Communication: Scoping ambiguous problems with clients, stakeholder demos, working with client engineering teams, code review, transparent reporting of model limitations, root-cause analysis, technical documentation
